subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Be like chalk and cheese

options.text: To be completely different from each other
To be very similar to each other
To have a close relation with another person
To be distantly related to each other

solution: The correct answer is: **To be completely different from each other.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Be like chalk and cheese"** means two things or people that are completely different from each other. (एकदम अलग) • **Example: **Despite being twins, John and Jake are like chalk and cheese in their personalities. • **"To be completely different from each other" **refers to having no similarities at all, often in terms of characteristics, preferences, or nature. (पूरी तरह से अलग होना) • **Example: **Her approach to solving problems is completely different from mine; we are like chalk and cheese. • Hence, the idiom "Be like chalk and cheese" means to be completely different from each other. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To be completely different from each other. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To be very similar to each other** (एक दूसरे के बहुत समान होना): Sharing many of the same characteristics or qualities. • **Example:** The two sisters are very similar to each other in appearance and mannerisms. • **To have a close relation with another person** (किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के साथ निकट संबंध होना): Being emotionally or socially close to someone. • **Example: **She has a very close relation with her best friend from childhood. • **To be distantly related to each other** (एक दूसरे से दूर का संबंध होना): Having a distant familial or social connection. • **Example:** They are distantly related to each other through a common ancestor. 2f:Tb12, The correct answer is: **Sombre.**
